summary: A deliberately small Lua surface for first-time Schedule I modders.

types.name: ModOptions
types.summary: Names and identifies one Lua mod.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable lowercase ID such as yourname.my-first-mod.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name shown in logs and diagnostics.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Your mod version.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Your name or handle.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A short description of the mod.

types.name: ClothingOptions
types.summary: Controls how a clothing item is worn and displayed.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: feet, bottom, waist, top, outerwear, hands, neck, eyes, head, or wrist. A clone keeps its original slot when omitted.

fields.name: application
fields.description: body_layer, face_layer, or accessory. A clone keeps its original application when omitted.

fields.name: asset
fields.description: Base-game clothing asset path to use or retexture. Required when the item does not clone clothing.

fields.name: texture
fields.description: Optional PNG inside this mod folder that replaces the clothing texture.

fields.name: colorable
fields.description: Whether the player can choose a clothing color.

fields.name: default_color
fields.description: Default color such as white, black, red, sky_blue, navy, purple, or hot_pink.

fields.name: blocked_slots
fields.description: Other clothing slots blocked while this item is equipped.

types.name: ItemOptions
types.summary: Describes an item and where players can buy it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Local item ID. S1Lua prefixes it with the mod ID.

fields.name: clone
fields.description: Base-game item ID to clone. Recommended for first mods.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name. Required for items that do not clone another item.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Inventory description. A clone keeps its original description when omitted.

fields.name: category
fields.description: product, packaging, growing, tools, furniture, lighting, cash, consumable, equipment, ingredient, decoration, or clothing. Use the clothing table for equipable clothing settings.

fields.name: stack
fields.description: Maximum quantity in one slot, from 1 to 999.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Purchase price, zero or greater.

fields.name: resell
fields.description: Resell fraction from 0 to 1.

fields.name: legal
fields.description: Whether the item is legal.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: PNG path inside this mod folder.

fields.name: clothing
fields.description: Equipable-clothing settings. Cloning an existing clothing item is the most reliable starting point.

fields.name: shops
fields.description: Use compatible for every suitable shop, or provide a list of shop names.

types.name: Position
types.summary: A fixed position in the game world.

fields.name: x
fields.description: World X coordinate.

fields.name: y
fields.description: World Y coordinate.

fields.name: z
fields.description: World Z coordinate.

types.name: MarkerOptions
types.summary: Describes a phone map marker at a fixed position or following an NPC.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Local marker ID. S1Lua prefixes it with the mod ID.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Text shown beside the marker.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Fixed world position. Use this or npc, not both.

fields.name: npc
fields.description: NPC ID for a marker that follows that NPC. Use this or position, not both.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: PNG path inside this mod folder.

fields.name: text
fields.description: When the marker label is shown.

fields.name: visible
fields.description: Whether the marker starts visible.

types.name: PhoneCallOptions
types.summary: Describes a phone call with one or more lines of dialogue.

fields.name: caller
fields.description: Caller name when npc is not supplied.

fields.name: npc
fields.description: NPC ID whose name and portrait should be used.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: PNG caller portrait used when npc is not supplied.

fields.name: stages
fields.description: One to twenty lines shown in order.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable in-game NPC ID.

fields.name: name
fields.description: NPC full name.

fields.name: region
fields.description: NPC's assigned region.

fields.name: relationship
fields.description: Relationship from 0 for a stranger to 1 for the maximum.

fields.name: is_unlocked
fields.description: Whether the NPC is unlocked.

fields.name: is_dead
fields.description: Whether the NPC is dead.

types.name: TimeInfo
types.summary: The current in-game day and time.

fields.name: day
fields.description: Current weekday in lowercase.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Current 24-hour time such as 1330.

fields.name: formatted
fields.description: Current time formatted for display.

fields.name: elapsed_days
fields.description: Number of elapsed game days.

fields.name: is_night
fields.description: Whether it is currently nighttime.

fields.name: is_sleeping
fields.description: Whether sleep is in progress.

fields.name: primary
fields.description: Weather component with the highest weight.

fields.name: sunny
fields.description: Sunny weight from 0 to 1.

fields.name: cloudy
fields.description: Cloudy weight from 0 to 1.

fields.name: rainy
fields.description: Rainy weight from 0 to 1.

fields.name: stormy
fields.description: Stormy weight from 0 to 1.

fields.name: snowy
fields.description: Snowy weight from 0 to 1.

fields.name: foggy
fields.description: Foggy weight from 0 to 1.

fields.name: windy
fields.description: Windy weight from 0 to 1.

fields.name: hail
fields.description: Hail weight from 0 to 1.

fields.name: sleet
fields.description: Sleet weight from 0 to 1.

fields.name: cash
fields.description: Cash currently carried by the player.

fields.name: online
fields.description: Current online account balance.

fields.name: net_worth
fields.description: Current total net worth reported by the game.

types.name: ProgressInfo
types.summary: The player's current rank and XP.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Stable lowercase rank ID such as street_rat or shot_caller.

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Current tier within the rank.

fields.name: xp
fields.description: XP earned within the current tier.

fields.name: total_xp
fields.description: Total XP accumulated across all ranks.

fields.name: xp_to_next_tier
fields.description: XP threshold for completing the current tier.

types.name: PlayerInfo
types.summary: The local player's current status and position.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Current player name.

fields.name: health
fields.description: Current health.

fields.name: max_health
fields.description: Maximum supported health.

fields.name: is_dead
fields.description: Whether the player is dead.

fields.name: is_in_vehicle
fields.description: Whether the player is currently in a vehicle.

fields.name: is_sleeping
fields.description: Whether the player is currently sleeping.

fields.name: is_arrested
fields.description: Whether the player is under arrest.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Stable lowercase ID for the player's current region.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Current world position with x, y, and z coordinates.

types.name: QuestInfo
types.summary: Basic details about a base-game quest.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Normalized quest identifier.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Quest title shown in game.

bindings.summary: Starts your mod and sets its identity and display information.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Mod identity and display information.

examples: local mod = s1.mod { id = "alex.golden-cuke", name = "Golden Cuke" }

bindings.summary: Writes an informational line to the MelonLoader log.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Message to write.

bindings.summary: Writes a warning to the MelonLoader log.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Warning to write.

bindings.summary: Returns the current in-game day and time, or nil when no save is loaded.
Returns the current weather conditions, or nil until they are available.
Returns current cash, online balance, and net worth. Values are zero until balance information is available.
Returns the player's current rank and XP, or nil until this information is available.
Returns the local player's current status, or nil until the player has spawned.
Creates an item and optionally adds it to shops.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Item fields and optional shop placement.

examples: mod:item { id = "golden_cuke", clone = "cuke", name = "Golden Cuke", price = 250, shops = "compatible" }
mod:item { id = "painted_cap", clone = "cap", name = "Painted Cap", clothing = { texture = "painted-cap.png", colorable = false } }

bindings.summary: Runs a function when a supported game event occurs.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Supported event name; your editor suggests every choice.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Function to run. sleep_ended provides minutes skipped; trash_recycled provides the number of objects processed.

bindings.summary: Loads a helper Lua file from this mod folder.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative .lua path inside this mod folder; the extension may be omitted.

bindings.summary: Runs a function once after the chosen number of gameplay seconds.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Delay from 0.05 to 86400 seconds; paused game time does not advance it.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Function to run once.

examples: mod:after(5, function() s1.log("Five seconds passed") end)

bindings.summary: Runs a function repeatedly at the chosen interval.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Time between runs, from 0.05 to 86400 seconds. Pauses do not count, and missed intervals are not replayed.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Function to run at each interval.

examples: local timer_id = mod:every(60, function() s1.log("One minute passed") end)

bindings.summary: Stops a delayed or repeating function created by this mod.

parameters.name: timer_id
parameters.description: Timer ID returned by mod:after or mod:every.

bindings.summary: Reads a value previously saved by this mod.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Storage key.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: Value returned when the key has not been saved.

bindings.summary: Saves a string, number, boolean, or nil in the current save file.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Storage key.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to save; nil removes it.

bindings.summary: Asks the game to save now and returns whether the request was accepted.
Adds or removes carried cash after the game is loaded.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Cash delta from -1000000000 to 1000000000. Positive adds cash; negative removes it.

parameters.name: visualize
parameters.description: Whether the game shows the cash change on the HUD.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Whether the game plays its cash-change sound.

examples: mod:on("game_loaded", function() mod:change_cash(250, true, true) end)

bindings.summary: Adds XP and returns true when successful. In multiplayer, only the lobby host can add XP.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Positive whole-number XP award from 1 to 1000000.

bindings.summary: Finds an NPC by ID and provides functions for working with them.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Stable NPC ID such as benji_coleman.

bindings.summary: Creates a phone map marker after the save finishes loading.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Marker identity, target, and presentation.

bindings.summary: Starts a simple phone call. Returns false when the chosen NPC is unavailable.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Caller and staged text.

bindings.summary: Finds a base-game quest by title or ID so you can read its details and events.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Quest title such as Getting Started, or ID such as gettingstarted.

bindings.summary: Returns the NPC's current details, or nil when that NPC is unavailable.
Shows temporary world-space text above the NPC.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text to show.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Display duration from 0.25 to 60 seconds.

bindings.summary: Sends the player a phone message from the NPC.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Message to send.

bindings.summary: Changes the NPC's relationship by an amount from -5 to 5.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Relationship delta.

bindings.summary: Unlocks the NPC as though the player met them directly.
Runs a function when the NPC's relationship changes, they are unlocked, or they die.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: NPC event name.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Function to run. relationship_changed provides the new relationship; unlocked provides the unlock type and notification setting.

bindings.summary: Returns the quest's current details, or nil when the quest is unavailable.
Runs a function when the quest is completed or failed.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Quest event name.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Function to run.

events.name: game_loading
events.summary: The game is about to load save data.

events.name: game_loaded
events.summary: The save has loaded and gameplay is ready.

events.name: scene_changing
events.summary: The game is leaving the current scene.

events.name: before_save
events.summary: The game is about to save.

events.name: sleep_ended
events.summary: Sleep ended. The function receives the number of minutes skipped.

parameters.name: minutes_skipped
parameters.description: Number of in-game minutes skipped while sleeping.

events.name: xp_changed
events.summary: XP changed; call s1.progress() to read the new values.

events.name: rank_up
events.summary: The player advanced to a new tier or rank.

events.name: player_ready
events.summary: The local player has spawned and s1.player() is ready.

events.name: trash_recycled
events.summary: The local player finished recycling. The function receives the number of objects processed. A filled trash bag counts as one object.

parameters.name: item_count
parameters.description: Number of trash objects processed by the recycler.
